test_title: PYST 23: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 10 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

This change is responsible for a recent ______ the number of cases of cancer in this age group.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Rise in'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** sentence is looking for** a preposition that can fittingly connect the noun phrase 'a recent ____' with 'the number of cases of cancer'.
 
• The preposition** 'in'** is the appropriate choice because it signifies one thing happening within something else here.
 
• Thus,** 'a recent rise in the number of cases'** perfectly illustrates the increase which occurred within this specific scope, namely 'the number of cases of cancer in this age group'.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'This change is responsible for a recent rise in the number of cases of cancer in this age group'*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Rise to' **and **'rise at'** are incorrect as they are prepositions which do not imply the internal change in the given category.
 
• **'Rise of',** while it can be used to imply an increase, is not the correct usage here. 'Of' would imply the rise is separate from 'the number of cases of cancer', not a change within it.
